en.headline: Missing Tseung Kwan O woman found alive on Kwun Tong hillside
en.dek: Police said 60-year-old Ngan Lai-ching, missing since 24 July, was located near On Luen Village with minor abrasions and airlifted to hospital in a conscious state.
body: A 60-year-old woman who had been missing for 11 days was found alive on a hillside near On Luen Village in Kwun Tong on Monday afternoon, police said.

Ngan Lai-ching left her home at Kwong Ming Court in Tseung Kwan O on the morning of 24 July without a mobile phone or Octopus card. Her family reported her missing the next day and police classified the case as high-risk. The search had been hampered by a typhoon and successive days of heavy rain.

Civil Aid Service personnel discovered one of her shoes at about 11.30am, with the other found about 10 metres further up the slope near the Tseung Kwan O Chinese Permanent Cemetery. She sustained abrasions to her hands and legs and was airlifted to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital in a conscious condition. Police said no suspicious circumstances were detected.

zh.headline: 將軍澳失蹤11日女子在觀塘山邊尋回
zh.dek: 警方表示，60歲區麗貞自7月24日失蹤後，周一在觀塘安聯村附近山坡尋回，手腳擦傷，清醒送院，無可疑情況。
body: 一名失蹤11日的60歲女子周一午間在觀塘安聯村附近山坡被尋回，警方表示她清醒送院。
區麗貞於7月24日早上離開將軍澳廣明苑住所後失蹤，當時未有帶手機或八達通。家人翌日報案，警方列為高風險失蹤人士。搜救工作早前受颱風及連日大雨影響。
民安隊人員約上午11時半發現她其中一隻鞋，另一隻鞋在附近約10米較高位置尋獲。她手腳有擦傷，由直升機送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院，情況清醒。警方指無可疑情況。
